content.name: Wikimedia Living Heritage list for Cameroon

attributes.steward: Wikimedia community (Wiki Loves Living Heritage), generated from Wikidata.
attributes.items: Bikutsi, Toghu, taro with yellow sauce (achu), Poulet DG, Ndolé, the Logone pony, Ikok, Abbia, Ekpang Nkwukwo, Kodomma, Ngondo, Nguon, the Nyem-Nyem festival, the Lekāk Míá Mezoó Festival, bend-skin, makossa, Fang Ngil masks, Cameroonian French, and a proverb, On n'insulte le roi que derrière la case, plus other items listed only by number.
attributes.use: A list of names that points to things worth documenting. I could not open the page to check each item, so the entries are names only.
